files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings_data/', entry_type='files')
for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = filename.split('__')
    # rest is like 'slides.ppt' or 'video_recording.mp4'
    # Split on last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = rest
        ext = ''
    # Create directory named file_name under meetings_data
    dir_path = f"~/documents/work/meetings_data/{file_name}/"
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True)
    # New file name: date.ext
    new_filename = f"{date_part}.{ext}" if ext else date_part
    dest_path = f"~/documents/work/meetings_data/{file_name}/{new_filename}"
    # Move the file
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_path)
    print(f"Moved {filename} to {dest_path}")
